description.value: Something Sweet is a dessert cafe tucked into the heart of Steveston, Richmond's historic fishing-village waterfront, where it draws locals and tourists alike with handmade shaved-ice bingsu, fresh in-house ice cream, and Taiwanese-Western fusion treats like dessert toasts and cheesecake baked nightly. Owned by Ricky and Alicia, who bring over 25 years of BC food-service experience, the shop prides itself on fresh, house-made ingredients. Cyclists riding the Steveston boardwalk routes will find it a natural sweet stop near the busy waterfront.
